_comment: Shared update-channel registry. The array order is the stability rank: the most stable channel first. Adding or removing a channel is a data edit here plus its locale keys; every driver reads this file (macOS and Linux through _shared/lua/updater/channels.lua, the pages through _shared/ui/_generated/update_channel_registry.js, Windows through windows/_generated/update_channels.ahk, the launcher through UpdateChannels.generated.swift; the last three are generated by tools/codegen/codegen-update-channels.cjs). tag is a structured matcher, never a regular expression, so no dialect has to be translated between JavaScript, PCRE and Lua patterns: core is 'semver' (any X.Y.Z without leading zeros) or one exact X.Y.Z, and prerelease is false (no prerelease part) or { label, counter } (label.N with N >= 1 when counter is true). The file uses no JSON null: the shared Lua JSON decoder turns null into a non-nil sentinel. aliases are accepted when a persisted value is read. unreleased_build_channel is followed by a build whose version belongs to no channel (a source checkout). github_prerelease is the flag the release workflow sets for the channel's tags; sparkle_feed is the channel's appcast file on the sparkle-appcasts branch.
